tool.name: Screen.seqs
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$fasta' fasta.dat && ln -s '$names' names.dat && ln -s '$groups' groups.dat && ln -s '$qfile' qfile.dat && ln -s '$count' count.dat && ln -s '$taxonomy' taxonomy.dat && ln -s '$summary' summary.dat && #if $contigsrep.usecontigs == "yes": ln -s '$contigsrep.contigsreport' contigsreport.dat && #end if #if $alignrep.usealign == "yes": ln -s '$alignrep.alignreport' alignreport.dat && #end if
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #silent $mothur_args.append("fasta=fasta.dat") #if int($start) > -1: #silent $mothur_args.append("start=" + str($start)) #end if #if int($end) > -1: #silent $mothur_args.append("end=" + str($end)) #end if #if int($minlength) > -1: #silent $mothur_args.append("minlength=" + str($minlength)) #end if #if int($maxlength) > -1: #silent $mothur_args.append("maxlength=" + str($maxlength)) #end if #if int($maxambig) > -1: #silent $mothur_args.append("maxambig=" + str($maxambig)) #end if #if int($maxhomop) > -1: #silent $mothur_args.append("maxhomop=" + str($maxhomop)) #end if #if int($criteria) > -1: #silent $mothur_args.append("criteria=" + str($criteria)) #end if #if $optimize: #set $mothur_arg = "optimize=" + (str($optimize).replace(',','-')) #silent $mothur_args.append($mothur_arg) #end if #if $qfile: #silent $mothur_args.append("qfile=qfile.dat") #end if #if $names: #silent $mothur_args.append("name=names.dat") #end if #if $groups: #silent $mothur_args.append("group=groups.dat") #end if #if $taxonomy: #silent $mothur_args.append("taxonomy=taxonomy.dat") #end if #if $count: #silent $mothur_args.append("count=count.dat") #end if #if $summary: #silent $mothur_args.append("summary=summary.dat") #end if #if $contigsrep.usecontigs == "yes": #silent $mothur_args.append("contigsreport=contigsreport.dat") #silent $mothur_args.append("minoverlap=" + str($contigsrep.minoverlap)) #silent $mothur_args.append("ostart=" + str($contigsrep.ostart)) #silent $mothur_args.append("oend=" + str($contigsrep.oend)) #silent $mothur_args.append("mismatches=" + str($contigsrep.mismatches)) #end if #if $alignrep.usealign == "yes": #silent $mothur_args.append("alignreport=alignreport.dat") #silent $mothur_args.append("minsim=" + str($alignrep.minsim)) #silent $mothur_args.append("minscore=" + str($alignrep.minscore)) #silent $mothur_args.append("maxinsert=" + str($alignrep.maxinsert)) #end if #silent $mothur_args.append("processors='\"${GALAXY_SLOTS:-8}\"'")
echo 'screen.seqs(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log ## mothur 1.48 writes the report outputs as 'good.[extension]' literally, ## because of a missing comma in its output pattern #if $contigsrep.usecontigs == "yes": && mv 'contigsreport.good.[extension]' contigsreport.good.contigs.report #end if #if $alignrep.usealign == "yes": && mv 'alignreport.good.[extension]' alignreport.good.align.report #end if

param.label: fasta - Fasta to screen
start - Remove sequences that start after position (ignored when negative)
end - Remove sequences that end before position (ignored when negative)
minlength - Remove sequences shorter than (ignored when negative)
maxlength - Remove sequences longer than (ignored when negative)
maxambig - Remove sequences with ambiguous bases greater than (ignored when negative)
maxhomop - Remove sequences with homopolymers greater than (ignored when negative)
criteria - Percent of sequences that an optimize value must match to be retained (ignored when negative)
optimize - Optimize selected parameters
qfile - Sequence Quality file to screen
name - Sequence Names to screen
group - Groups to screen
summary file - as created by summary.seqs
param.help: saves processing time when screening with parameters in the summary file

param.label: taxonomy - Taxonomy to screen
count - a count_table
Perform screening using an alignment report?
param.help: An alignment report is created by the align.seqs tool. If you provide the alignment report file you can screen your sequences using the following parameters: minsim, minscore, and maxinsert

param.label: alignreport - Align Report to screen with
minsim - Minimum similarity to template sequences during alignment
minscore - Minimum search score during alignment (ignored when negative)
maxinsert - Maximum number of insertions during alignment (ignored when negative)
Perform screening using a contigsreport?
param.help: A contigsreport is created by the make.contigs tool. If you provide the contigs report file you can screen your sequences using the following parameters: minoverlap, ostart, oend and mismatches

param.label: contigsreport - Contigs Report to screen with
param.help: this file is created by the make.contigs command

param.label: minoverlap - Minimum overlap length (ignored when negative)
ostart - Position the overlap must start by (ignored when negative)
oend - Position the overlap must end after (ignored when negative)
mismatches - Maximum number of mismatches (ignored when negative)

tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The screen.seqs_ command enables you to keep sequences that fulfill certain user defined criteria. Furthermore, it enables you to cull those sequences not meeting the criteria from a name_, group_, or align.report_ file.
.. _name: https://mothur.org/wiki/name_file/ .. _group: https://mothur.org/wiki/group_file/ .. _align.report: https://mothur.org/wiki/align.seqs/ .. _screen.seqs: https://mothur.org/wiki/screen.seqs/
